Title: A Vision Conceived
Historical Details: Gopal, Majin Paul, Christopher Balraj, and Kiruba envision building a team of professionals in Cayman who share a deep love for cricket.

Title: The Birth of CSK
Historical Details: Cayman Super Kings is officially founded under the leadership of Christopher Balraj; Rahul Garg joins towards the end of 2022.

Title: Tournament Debut & World Cup Qualifier
Historical Details: CSK plays its first competitive tournament. Christopher Balraj represents the Cayman Islands national team in Bermuda for the World Cup Qualifiers.

Title: Captaincy Handover & International T10
Historical Details: Rahul Garg takes over captaincy; Rahul represents CSK in the international T10 league playing alongside David Warner, Carlos Brathwaite, and Alex Hales.

Title: T10 Knockouts & Dual International T10
Historical Details: CSK qualifies for T10 knockouts under Rahul Garg. Chris Balraj joins international T10 under Shabaz Nadeem; Rahul & Gokul join National Training Squad.

Title: Developing the Next Generation
Historical Details: Local school talent pathway, training alongside senior players, and continuing the upward journey of Cayman Super Kings.
